Hi Jonas / Monica —

Thanks for the quick handover call this morning. To confirm the billing picture from our side after the close on May 31: Orion is issuing invoices under our EU subsidiary name and legal entity. Please route invoices and invoice headers to the following entity: 

Orion AI Solutions Ltd.
Registered address: Via Europa 12, 20121 Milan, Italy
VAT/Tax ID: IT12345678901
Attn: Invoicing Team (invoices@orionai.com)

Payment instructions: for the first 60 days post-close, payments will be held in an escrow account managed by Vespa Bank (treasury@vespa-bank.com). Vespa will release payments to our operating account once ledger migration is complete (expected mid-July).

I've attached the Entity Certificate and the preliminary escrow instructions from Vespa. Can you confirm Redwood's required invoice header fields and whether you need a PO# or signed authority to redirect payments to Vespa for the transitional period? Also please confirm if Redwood needs a VAT registration letter to tag invoices correctly in your system.

Appreciate a short checklist we can sign off on this week so finance can schedule the first billing run.

Best,
Elena Rossi

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Ledger & billing alignment for Orion AI acquisition — remit & escrow next steps

Elena —

Thanks for the details and attachments. This is the right level of info; below is Redwood's proposed minimal acceptance criteria to update our billing system and start routing invoices to the Orion entity / Vespa escrow account during the transition window: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Redwood requires a signed Remit Authorization form from Orion authorizing Vespa to receive Redwood payments on Orion's behalf. See attached "Redwood_proposed_remit_form.xlsx" for the required fields.
- Finance needs the legal entity full name, VAT number, and registered address (you provided these — thank you).
- For VAT tagging we need a copy of the VAT registration letter or confirmation from Italian tax authority (if you can provide that, we'll map the VAT code to the EU ledger).
- PO#: Not required for Redwood by default, but if your procurement ops need one for vendor reconciliation we can include a PO field on the invoice; please confirm.

Temporary workflow (first 60 days):
- Redwood will issue invoices to "Orion AI Solutions Ltd." with invoice header as provided and send PDF invoices to invoices@orionai.com and treasury@vespa-bank.com.
- Payments sent to Vespa's escrow account will be accepted; Redwood will flag those invoices with "ESCROW-HOLD" metadata until Vespa confirms release.

Timeline proposal:
- Tue 18 May: Receive signed remit form + VAT registration letter (if available).
- Wed 19 May: Redwood updates billing system and shares sample invoice PDF for your review.
- By Mon 31 May: First commercial invoice post-close issued under Orion AI Solutions Ltd.

Questions for you:
1) Who is the authorized signatory at Orion for remit changes (name & title)?
2) Can Vespa confirm the specific wire reference field Redwood should include to speed reconciliation?

I'll assign Monica to lead the coordination with our AP team; Grace will produce the sample invoice template for your review. Monica — can you pick this up?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachment:
- Redwood_proposed_remit_form.xlsx

From: Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@orionai.com>

Subject: Re: Ledger & billing alignment for Orion AI acquisition — remit & escrow next steps

Jonas / team —

Quick clarifications from Vespa and Orion treasury:

- Vespa confirms the escrow account will act as a collection point for Redwood invoices for a 60-day handover. Vespa will provide a reconciliation file daily for all incoming wires.
- Required wire reference: ORION-REMIT-[vendor shortname]-INV# (please include vendor shortname "REDWOOD" when you add the wire reference so their reconciliation script maps correctly).
- Attached is Vespa_wire_instruction_20270517.pdf with the escrow account IBAN/BIC and the reconciliation contact.

On the authorization: we'll route a DocuSign authority for Jonas/Redwood to accept payments to Vespa on Orion's behalf. The signatory will be Elena Rossi (Head of Finance). Link: https://docusign.com/boxes/ORION-AUTH-20270517

Note: once ledger migration is complete, Vespa will publish the final remittance endpoint and Redwood should switch the invoice header remit to the operating account we will share in July.

Marco Bianchi
Head of Treasury, Orion AI
